    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">从零搭建后台？Vite8+Vue3.5 通用Admin模板，开箱即用！</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<p>你还在从零搭建后台系统吗？试试这款最新研发的<strong>vite8.x+vue3+pinia3</strong>搭配<strong>element-plus、naive-ui、arco-design</strong>组件库构建中后台管理系统模板。</p>
<p><img alt="未标题-后台管理---element" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/221743/202610/221743-20261028230526071-1990232978.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p><img alt="未标题-后台管理--naive" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/221743/202610/221743-20261028230602171-966715284.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p><img alt="未标题-后台管理---arco" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/221743/202610/221743-20261028230545333-1903738193.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<h2>功能特性</h2>

<thead>
<tr>
<th>
<div class="ybc-p">特性分类</div>

</th>

</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td>
<div class="ybc-p">🎨 <strong>UI 组件库</strong>​</div>
</td>
<td>
<div class="ybc-p"><strong>多版本可选</strong>​</div>
</td>
<td>
<div class="ybc-p">提供 <strong>ArcoDesign</strong>、<strong>Element Plus</strong>、<strong>Naive UI</strong>​ 三个版本，可按团队技术栈自由选择</div>
</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>
<div class="ybc-p">🌗 <strong>主题模式</strong>​</div>
</td>
<td>
<div class="ybc-p"><strong>亮色 + 暗黑主题</strong>​</div>
</td>
<td>
<div class="ybc-p">内置双主题模式，支持一键切换，暗黑模式深度适配所有组件与业务页面</div>
</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>
<div class="ybc-p">📐 <strong>布局系统</strong>​</div>
</td>
<td>
<div class="ybc-p"><strong>4 种布局模式</strong>​</div>
</td>
<td>
<div class="ybc-p">内置经典、分栏、纵向、横向四种布局，满足不同后台系统的导航习惯</div>
</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>
<div class="ybc-p">🌍 <strong>国际化</strong>​</div>
</td>
<td>
<div class="ybc-p"><strong>多语言支持</strong>​</div>
</td>
<td>
<div class="ybc-p">集成 <code class="hyc-common-markdown__code__inline">vue-i18n</code>，内置中文、英文、繁体三种语言包，可快速扩展其他语种</div>
</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>
<div class="ybc-p">🧭 <strong>导航体验</strong>​</div>
</td>
<td>
<div class="ybc-p"><strong>面包屑 + 标签栏</strong>​</div>
</td>
<td>
<div class="ybc-p">顶部面包屑导航 + 多标签页快捷切换，支持<strong>页面缓存</strong>，关闭标签不丢失操作状态</div>
</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>
<div class="ybc-p">📂 <strong>菜单与导航</strong>​</div>
</td>
<td>
<div class="ybc-p"><strong>多级菜单 + 侧边栏收缩</strong>​</div>
</td>
<td>
<div class="ybc-p">路由配置驱动多级菜单，侧边栏支持完全收起/展开，提升内容区可视面积</div>
</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>
<div class="ybc-p">⚙️ <strong>系统与设置</strong>​</div>
</td>
<td>
<div class="ybc-p"><strong>全屏 + 抽屉设置</strong>​</div>
</td>
<td>
<div class="ybc-p">支持页面全屏展示，系统配置面板以侧边抽屉形式呼出，实时预览布局与主题变更</div>
</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>
<div class="ybc-p">📦 <strong>业务模块</strong>​</div>
</td>
<td>
<div class="ybc-p"><strong>开箱即用的业务套件</strong>​</div>
</td>
<td>
<div class="ybc-p">整合图表、表格、表单、动态权限控制、错误处理等常见后台模块，降低开发成本</div>
</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>
<div class="ybc-p">🧩 <strong>扩展能力</strong>​</div>
</td>
<td>
<div class="ybc-p"><strong>优雅简约 + 可扩展</strong>​</div>
</td>
<td>
<div class="ybc-p">界面设计简约克制，架构层面预留布局模板扩展点，方便自行定制专属布局</div>
</td>
</tr>

</table>

<h2>项目框架结构</h2>
<p><img alt="image" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/221743/202610/221743-20261028231253257-1374464126.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p><img alt="image" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/221743/202610/221743-20261028231310065-1346956981.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p><img alt="image" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/221743/202610/221743-20261028231319422-206617027.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p><img alt="image" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/221743/202610/221743-20261028231327815-925272144.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p><img alt="image" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/221743/202610/221743-20261028231335801-1121358726.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p><img alt="image" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/221743/202610/221743-20261028231403772-1934144024.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<h2>vite-vue3-admin布局模板</h2>
<p><img alt="image" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/221743/202610/221743-20261028231452118-2013706476.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p><img alt="image" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/221743/202610/221743-20261028231459224-770923153.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<pre class="language-html highlighter-hljs"><code>&lt;script setup&gt;
  import { appState } from '@/pinia/modules/app'

  // 引入布局模板
  import Classic from './template/classic/index.vue'
  import Columns from './template/columns/index.vue'
  import Vertical from './template/vertical/index.vue'
  import Horizontal from './template/horizontal/index.vue'

  const appstate = appState()

  const LayoutMap = {
    'classic': Classic,
    'columns': Columns,
    'vertical': Vertical,
    'horizontal': Horizontal
  }
&lt;/script&gt;

&lt;template&gt;
  &lt;div class="vuadmin__container"&gt;
    &lt;component :is="LayoutMap[appstate.config.layout]" /&gt;
  &lt;/div&gt;
&lt;/template&gt;</code></pre>
<p><strong>经典布局结构</strong></p>
<pre class="language-html highlighter-hljs"><code>&lt;script setup&gt;
  import { appState } from '@/pinia/modules/app'

  import Toolbar from '@/layouts/components/toolbar/index.vue'
  import Sidebar from '@/layouts/components/sidebar/index.vue'
  import Menus from '@/layouts/components/menus/index.vue'
  import Breadcrumb from '@/layouts/components/Breadcrumb.vue'
  import Tabview from '@/layouts/components/Tabview.vue'
  import Main from '@/layouts/components/Main.vue'

  const appstate = appState()
&lt;/script&gt;

&lt;template&gt;
  &lt;div class="vuadmin__layout flexbox flex-col"&gt;
    &lt;Toolbar /&gt;

    &lt;div class="vuadmin__layout-body flex1 flexbox"&gt;
      &lt;!-- 侧边栏 --&gt;
      &lt;div class="vuadmin__layout-sidebar"&gt;
        &lt;Sidebar /&gt;
      &lt;/div&gt;

      &lt;!-- 菜单栏 --&gt;
      &lt;div class="vuadmin__layout-menus" :class="{'hidden': appstate.config.collapsed}"&gt;
        &lt;a-scrollbar&gt;
          &lt;Menus :rootRouteEnable="false" /&gt;
        &lt;/a-scrollbar&gt;
      &lt;/div&gt;

      &lt;!-- 右侧主内容区 --&gt;
      &lt;div class="vuadmin__layout-main flex1 flexbox flex-col"&gt;
        &lt;!-- 面包屑导航 --&gt;
        &lt;Breadcrumb /&gt;

        &lt;!-- 标签页 --&gt;
        &lt;Tabview /&gt;

        &lt;!-- 内容区 --&gt;
        &lt;Main /&gt;
      &lt;/div&gt;
    &lt;/div&gt;
  &lt;/div&gt;
&lt;/template&gt;</code></pre>
<p><img alt="image" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/221743/202610/221743-20261028231706006-21398443.png" class="lazyload"></p>

<p><img alt="image" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/221743/202610/221743-20261028231725456-1875916631.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p><img alt="image" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/221743/202610/221743-20261028231731935-7108950.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p><img alt="image" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/221743/202610/221743-20261028231740580-924926597.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p><img alt="image" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/221743/202610/221743-20261028231756848-1825436083.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p><img alt="image" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/221743/202610/221743-20261028231814045-1231073455.png" class="lazyload"></p>

<p><img alt="image" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/221743/202610/221743-20261028231831142-1913683648.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p><img alt="image" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/221743/202610/221743-20261028231840139-834166567.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p><img alt="image" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/221743/202610/221743-20261028231854778-34151827.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>爆肝一周！自研 Vite8 + Vue3.5 清爽型通用后台模板，支持三套 UI 版本。</p>
<h2>适用场景</h2>
<ul>
<li>中后台管理系统（CMS / OA / ERP / 数据平台）</li>
<li>快速原型验证</li>
<li>新手学习 Vue3 + Vite8 工程化</li>
<li>多项目复用同一套骨架</li>
</ul>
<div class="ybc-p">这套模板的目标不是“功能堆满”，而是：</div>
<blockquote>
<div class="ybc-p"><strong>清爽、好改、不绑架业务、能直接写页面</strong></div>
</blockquote>
<div class="ybc-p">Vite8 的极速冷启 + Vue3.5 的 Composition API + Pinia3 的简洁状态，</div>
<div class="ybc-p">再配合三套 UI 版本与完整后台骨架。</div>
<p><strong>如果对你有启发，欢迎点赞 / 收藏 / 转发</strong></p>
